thread:
maria: ok quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need a compact action list for staged releases so this doesn't repeat. TL;DR: three recurring failure patterns: 1) large blast radius from flags, 2) missing auto-rollback thresholds, 3) lack of short-term ownership for canary alerts.
liam: agree. can we keep the checklist to runnable items? e.g., gating checks + runbook pointer + owner.
anika: i'll take the feature-flag blast-radius guard implementation. proposal: default max percentage per flag = 10%, and an emergency cutoff (auto-rollback) if error rate > 5% for 2 consecutive minutes.
maria: sounds good. add measurement: error spike measured as 5xx rate vs baseline 5xx, smoothed over 1m. document where baseline comes from.
liam: i'll own the auto-rollback plumbing in the rollout controller. ETA 2 weeks. i'll add a canary metric that emits a 'rollback-signal' when threshold breached.
jay: we'll need an observability alert that maps to an oncall page with runbook. i'll create the alert and a minimal dashboard. ETA 4 business days.
anika: quick snippet for the flag CLI i'm going to land so product can see defaults:
```
flagctl set-safety --name staged_release_guard --max-percentage 10 --auto-rollback-threshold 5 --window 120s
```
liam: nice. question: do we want cross-region aggregation or per-region? during yesterday's outage the spike was only in us-west.
maria: start per-region to avoid global blips, but allow a global override. document expected behavior in the checklist.
incidents-bot: note: postmortem 2026-03-22 created, link: https://redwood/pm/2026-03-22
deploy-bot: canary started for infra/rollout-controller at 2318460000
jay: owners + dates summary i propose: Anika -> feature-flag guard (2026-04-07), Liam -> rollback signal + controller (2026-04-07), Jay -> alert + dashboard (2026-03-30), Maria -> checklist + runbook consolidation (2026-03-29).
maria: agreed. i'll create a recurring 2-week cadence to review staged-release telemetry and any near-miss incidents. recurring invite to eng-platform, eng-sre, oncall.
liam: i'll open the PR for the rollout-controller changes today and tag reviewers.
anika: i'll draft the flag defaults RFC and attach a short testing checklist for product/team signoff.
jay: FYI will add a low-friction endpoint that oncall can trigger to force a rollback during an active canary (manual emergency abort).
maria: excellent. last item: add a smoke test to the canary that runs user-critical path checks within the first 2 minutes and surfaces failures to the rollback signal.
liam: noted. will include smoke probe in controller.
maria: thanks everyone — i'll track these in the postmortem follow-ups doc and ping weekly until closed. :white_check_mark:
